facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: pressure release during a planned shutdown on P-9503

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.
Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on P-9503, M-9503 and PT-9503 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on P-9503, M-9503 and PT-9503 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on P-9503, M-9503 and PT-9503 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in applying and verifying an isolation, specifically applying locks, tags and personal danger tags. P-9503 (dewatering pumps) is in service for pit dewatering. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 13 March 2026 an incident occurred on P-9503, M-9503 and PT-9503 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during a planned shutdown, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
